unit: Students can describe their daily study routines, discuss learning tools, and share advice on building good study habits while balancing school and family life.
objective: Describe your everyday study habits after school.

title: Warm up
subtitle: What do you usually do after school?
question: What do you usually do to study in the afternoon?

title: Useful Language (Part 1)
teacher_instructions: Read each phrase aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the phrases.

words.example: I do my homework every day after school.
words.check: When do you usually do your homework: in the afternoon or at night?

words.definition: to stop working or studying for a short time to rest
words.example: I usually take a break and drink some water after an hour.
words.check: When you take a break, do you usually watch TV or eat a snack?

title: Useful Language (Part 2)
teacher_instructions: Read each phrase aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and the example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the phrases.

words.definition: to read your class notes again to help you remember them
words.example: I review my notes before I start my English homework.
words.check: Do you prefer to review your notes on paper or on a computer?

words.definition: to end your classes for the day
words.example: I finish school at 3:00 p.m. and take the bus home.
words.check: Do you usually finish school in the afternoon or in the evening?

title: Conversation Builder
goal: Learn how to describe your daily study routine in order.

linkers.use: Introduce the first step of your routine.
Describe an activity you normally do later.

model: First, I finish school. After that, I take a short break. Then, I usually do my homework and review my notes.

your_turn.teacher: Ask the student: So, tell me about your study routine. What do you usually do after school?
your_turn.student: Well, first, I... After that, I... Then, I usually...

title: Let's practice
teacher_question: Imagine I'm a new student at your school and I want to know how you study. Tell me about your afternoon study routine using phrases like 'finish school', 'take a break', 'do homework', or 'review notes'.

title: Real-world scenario
role_a: You are a student. Describe your typical afternoon study routine.
role_b: Your tutor will act as your mentor. They will ask follow-up questions about what time you do each activity.
problem: You need to explain your after-school study habits to your mentor.
mission: Tell your mentor what time you finish school.
Describe your study routine using 'first', 'after that', and 'then'.
Answer your mentor's questions about what time you do your homework, take a break, and review your notes.
start: Tutor: Hi there! Let's talk about your study habits. So, what time do you finish school, and what do you do first?

title: Wrap-Up
recap: Vocabulary: do homework, take a break, review notes, finish school
Language chunks: First, I... / After that, I... / Then, I usually...
Skill: Describe everyday study habits after school.
final_task: Use one of today's phrases to tell me: What is the very first thing you do when you finish school?
challenge: Write down your study schedule for tomorrow using 'First', 'After that', and 'Then'!
